schema:
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, stock_count INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT p.product_id FROM products AS p WHERE (p.product_id, p.stock_count) IN (SELECT o.product_id, COUNT(o.quantity) FROM orders AS o WHERE o.quantity > 0)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant incorrectly groups subquery by product_id instead of scalar global aggregation
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT p.product_id FROM products AS p JOIN (SELECT o.product_id, COUNT(o.quantity) AS cnt FROM orders AS o WHERE o.quantity > 0 GROUP BY o.product_id) AS g ON p.product_id = g.product_id AND p.stock_count = g.cnt
